notes.title: Patch Notes – Love, Bugs & Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Coaches,

How’s your experience with the new big update so far? We hope it’s been as hot and exciting as you expected, because our tiny indie team really poured a lot of sweat, tears, and coffee into it.

Of course, just like in love, nothing is perfect the first time. This big update also had a few unexpected “slips,” but don’t worry—we’ve taken care of them as quickly as we could.

Here’s the list of bugs we’ve “executed”:
[list]
[*] Fixed a display issue with users not in the top 10 of the leaderboard.
[*] Fixed a UI issue on Steam Deck, so you can play smoothly whether it’s on the bed or the couch.
[*] Fixed an issue where a certain CG didn't unlock in the Gallery.
[*] Fixed an issue with the "Unlock All" function.
[*] Updated the random court logic so you won’t feel déjà vu anymore.
[/list]
If you find any other issues (even the tiniest ones), let us know. Our team will patch them up for you right away.

Now get back in the game and climb that leaderboard!

notes.title: 🎾 Big Update Coming to Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX!
notes.notes:
Hey, Coach!

Things are about to heat up at the academy!
 We’re thrilled to let you know that a massive update for Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX is dropping on [b]August 21 at 4PM PDT[/b] – and trust us, you won’t want to miss it.

This is the biggest update we’ve ever done – packed with juicy new content, improvements, and a few surprises that your favorite Angels have been dying to show you…

[b]Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming:[/b]
[list]
[*] Endless Mode – Think you’re the ultimate tennis player? Prove it! In this mode, your opponents get stronger after every match, but you’ve got to stay sharp and keep swinging. How long can you survive the heat? Oh – and we’re adding a Leaderboard, so you can finally show off your endurance and skills to the world. 
[*] Tennis Court Skins – We’re bringing fresh visual flair with new court skins inspired by real-life surfaces. Clay, grass, hard court – serve like a Grand Slam champion, but with your signature sexy twist.
[*] Custom Mode – Want to practice against your favorite Angel? Or maybe challenge the toughest one over and over again? In Custom Mode, you choose your opponent. Total freedom, total control… just how you like it. 
[/list]
More surprises and additions are on the way – and we’ll be sharing the full patch notes very soon. Stay tuned!

[b]Artbook DLC – Releasing August 21 at 4PM PDT[/b]
Want to take a deeper peek into the world of your Angels? The official Artbook DLC is launching on Steam at the same time as the big update.
It’s filled with exclusive artwork, behind-the-scenes sketches, and some... very revealing content. 

Artbook DLC link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3841440/Academy_Love_Saga_Tennis_Angels_EX_Artbook/

Thanks for always being there for your girls, Coach.
 Now go get ready — class is about to get a whole lot more interesting.

With love (and maybe a little trouble),
Dev team

notes.title: 🎾 Progress Update – We’re Keeping Our Promise! 🛠️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112658/73621b8dff81df63500ea399dd84c664af943e2a.png[/img]
Hey everyone!

Previously, we promised to bring you some exciting new free features for Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX – and today, we’re thrilled to share a sneak peek at how things are coming along!

The upcoming free update is progressing smoothly, and we’re happy to say that Endless Mode is nearing completion. In this mode, you'll face opponents that get tougher after each match – how long can you survive against an ever-growing challenge? 💪🔥

🎖️ We're also adding a Personal Record Board, so you can keep track of your highest scores and push yourself to go further every time!

[b]🎨 Tennis Court Skins
[/b]We’ve started implementing beautiful new court designs inspired by real-world tennis arenas – from iconic green grass courts, to classic red clay, to vibrant blue hard courts. Whether you’re dreaming of Wimbledon or the US Open, now you can play in style – your style! 🏟️✨

Here’s a sneak peek at a few of the visuals from the update 👇
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112658/da3f79d6dddaa62c91312b53a2e57cc33738211d.png[/img]

We’re still polishing everything, but we wanted to give you this progress update and let you know: yes, we’re keeping our promise – and everything is coming along nicely!

[b]💖 One More Thing…
[/b]We’re also working on something special for fans who love the art and characters of Tennis Angels EX – an official Artbook is in the works!
It will feature concept art, character illustrations, and never-before-seen sketches from the game’s development. More details coming soon – stay tuned!

Thank you so much for your continued support for Tennis Angels EX! See you soon in the next update! 🎾

notes.title: 🎾 Hotfix Update – More Fixes + New CGs Unlocked! 🔥
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112658/73621b8dff81df63500ea399dd84c664af943e2a.png[/img]
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a new build for Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX with several important fixes and a little surprise for you all! Thank you for sticking with us — your feedback continues to help us improve the experience. ❤️

[b]🛠️ Change Logs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a white screen freeze (stuck game)
[*] Added new CGs for clothing-tearing scenes to the Gallery 💥
[*] Announcement about Unlock All not working for some players
[/list]
[b]🧩 About the Unlock All Function Issue:[/b]
Some players reported that the Unlock All feature didn’t work properly. Here’s why:
[list]
[*] Due to limitations of the Steam API, we currently have no reliable way to detect whether a player has reached the required 2-hour playtime.
[*] 🕒 Temporary Solution: Please launch the game and keep it running until you receive the achievement called "No Man Refund" on Steam (this should take around 2 continuous hours).
[*] You can Alt+Tab out and do other things in the meantime.
[*] Once the "No Man Refund" achievement is unlocked, the Unlock All feature will work correctly.
[*] We’re very sorry for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding and patience!
[*] 💬 If you're enjoying the game, leaving a review on Steam means the world to us. It not only helps us grow but also allows us to keep creating awesome content for everyone!
[/list]

Thanks for playing,
— Tennis Angels EX Dev Team 💖
